questions.question: Only after the results ______ carefully did the researchers realize the significance of the error.
questions.explanation: Only after + 명사절/부사구 뒤에 오는 동작이 먼저 완료된 것이므로 과거완료 수동태가 맞다.

questions.question: The data collected from the survey ______ that younger voters were more interested in the issue.
questions.explanation: 주어 The data는 집합명사처럼 보여도 여기서는 하나의 결과를 나타내며, 문맥상 과거 시제 suggested가 자연스럽다.

questions.question: No sooner had the plane taken off than the passengers ______ a sudden announcement from the captain.
questions.explanation: No sooner had A p.p. than B V-ed 구조에서는 뒤 절이 보통 과거형으로 온다.

questions.question: The professor, together with his assistants, ______ preparing the final draft for three hours.
questions.explanation: together with ~는 수일치에 영향을 주지 않으므로 핵심 주어 The professor에 맞춰 has been이 된다.

questions.question: The students were told ______ their phones during the exam.
questions.explanation: tell + 목적어 + to-v 구조이다. 부정은 not to use가 맞다.

questions.question: Such an attitude, if ______ often, can damage trust among team members.
questions.explanation: if + 과거분사는 if it is repeated의 축약형이다. 주어가 태도를 받는 것이므로 수동 의미가 필요하다.

questions.question: The number of applicants ______ increased significantly since the advertisement was posted.
questions.explanation: The number of ~는 단수 취급이므로 has increased가 맞다.

questions.question: The committee discussed whether the proposal was realistic and ______ financially possible.
questions.explanation: whether A and whether B처럼 병렬된 절이 되어야 한다. 앞의 whether에 맞춰 뒤도 whether it is가 자연스럽다.

questions.question: Written in simple language, the guide is easy ______ for beginners.
questions.explanation: easy to V 구조이다. 여기서는 the guide is easy to understand로, 의미상 “이해하기 쉽다”가 된다.

questions.question: The athletes, exhausted after the match, ______ to the locker room without saying a word.
questions.explanation: 쉼표로 끼워 넣은 exhausted after the match는 부가 설명이고, 본동사는 사건의 진행 순서를 나타내는 walked가 적절하다.
